narrative.name: NIST 800-53
narrative.splunkValue: We evidence each control family — AU-2 logging completeness, AC-2 account lifecycle, SI-4 system monitoring, CM-6 configuration compliance, and more — with per-control dashboards and tstats-backed reports suitable for a FedRAMP ConMon package.
narrative.whatItIs: The US federal catalogue of security and privacy controls. Version Rev.5 integrates privacy, supply-chain risk, and outcome-based language; it is the underpinning control set for FedRAMP authorisations and many state and sector programmes.
narrative.whoItAffects: US federal agencies, contractors supporting federal systems, FedRAMP cloud providers, and organisations that voluntarily adopt 800-53 as a gold-standard baseline (common in healthcare, finance, and critical infrastructure).
